Messages.Author: Tim
Messages.Body:
I wonder: will there be any other extentions to Jyhad / V:tES in the
future? If so, when ? Would it include new Clans or Bloodlines? Would it
include new cards or only re-editions of old ones ? Would it be
available in Europe ?

Tim

Messages.Author: Andy Kaiser
Messages.Body:
Tim,
There's been a lengthy discussion regarding this on the Jyhad
listserv between FRPG (who, I believe, currenty own the rights to the
game) and the folks on the mailing list. I've basically been a lurker to
this discussion, but from what I can see, don't hold your breath waiting
for a new expansion set. FRPG has relegated V:tES to the darkest corner of
its basement, hoping that it'll just go away. (And, as you might imagine,
this isn't making players all that happy...)

Andy
